SELECT
  t.id AS task_id,
  t.title AS task_title,
  t.status,
  t.priority,
  t.story_points,
  t.due_date,
  t.project_id,
  t.assignee_id,
  m.full_name AS assignee_name,
  m.email AS assignee_email,
  p.name AS project_name,
  t.updated_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - t.updated_at)) / 3600, 2) AS inactive_hours,
  (
    SELECT tl.logged_at
    FROM task_logs tl
    WHERE tl.task_id = t.id
    ORDER BY tl.logged_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS last_log_at
FROM tasks t
LEFT JOIN members m ON t.assignee_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.id
WHERE t.status NOT IN ('DONE')
  AND t.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY t.updated_at ASC;

INSERT INTO activity_history (task_id, member_id, action_type, old_value, new_value, metadata)
SELECT
  t.id,
  t.assignee_id,
  'STUCK_ALERT',
  t.status,
  t.status,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'source', 'n8n_flow6',
    'severity', CASE
      WHEN t.priority = 'URGENT' OR t.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '72 hours' OR (t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date < NOW()) THEN 'CRITICAL'
      WHEN t.priority = 'HIGH' OR t.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN 'HIGH'
      ELSE 'MEDIUM'
    END,
    'inactive_hours', ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - t.updated_at)) / 3600, 2),
    'scanned_at', NOW()
  )
FROM tasks t
WHERE t.status NOT IN ('DONE')
  AND t.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM activity_history ah
    WHERE ah.task_id = t.id
      AND ah.action_type = 'STUCK_ALERT'
      AND ah.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours'
  )
RETURNING *;
